material_news_signals.headline: Cardinals place rookie Jeremiyah Love on IR due to high ankle sprain
material_news_signals.description: The Arizona Cardinals are placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Tuesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: jeremiyah love s rookie season has taken another turn for the worse the arizona cardinals have placed the running back on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain that is expected to knock him out for four to five weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on tuesday the no 3 overall pick had previously dealt with a different ankle sprain head coach mike lafleur said monday the cardinals also announced on tuesday that wide receiver kendrick bourne has been placed on ir love went down in the first quarter of sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and did not return he d missed the previous two contests due to injury in six games the first rounder has generated 268 yards on 76 carries with one touchdown averaging 3 4 yards per tote the bulk of his production came in a 21 carry 90 yard performance in a week 3 loss to san francisco the cardinals used a top three pick on love in april believing he could add a dynamic game changing weapon to the backfield a la bijan robinson in atlanta or jahmyr gibbs in detroit love hasn t been healthy enough for most of the season to know for sure if he has that kind of sustainable upside arizona gave love a significant workload in his first preseason action handing it off 11 times and tossing him three passes the belief at the time was that getting reps early would prepare love for the regular season gauntlet instead he left that game with a nicked up ankle he hasn t seemed right since perhaps shutting the rb down for at least four games will allow him to come back fully healthy for the season s stretch run in the meantime tyler allgeier who sparked the cardinals comeback win over the cowboys figures to get the bulk of the totes fellow back bam knight currently is in the league s concussion protocol and veteran james conner remains on injured reserve evan hull is currently the healthy backup option for allgeier

material_news_signals.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
material_news_signals.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at

the line of scrimmage at times to run a quarterback sneak if the defensive look was right over the last seven seasons though that 39 s never happened 34 but it 39 s not like we 39 re scared to call the quarterback sneak 34 mahomes said 34 it 39 s just something that we haven 39 t done 34 data shows k c has been the nfl 39 s most hesitant team recently when it comes to sneaks according to pro football focus pff the chiefs have attempted eight sneak plays since mahomes was injured in 2019 with tight ends blake bell or noah gray under center for each attempt the team last attempted an material_news_signals.description: Can the freefalling Ravens somehow find new life against a Jaguars team looking to prove it's a top contender? In advance of Thursday night's game between Jacksonville and Baltimore, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
material_news_signals.body_text: the jaguars have only one more win than the ravens this season but the gap between these two teams suddenly feels much wider than their records suggest baltimore is facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against the jaguars who are one of three teams with more interceptions than touchdown passes allowed this season it would help if he could get the ball to leading receiver zay flowers who didn t have a catch on five targets four by fagnano last week 3 can the ravens avoid the abyss while the jaguars playoff odds continue to surge the ravens have watched their chances fade away they ve gone from a 70 playoff probability to 20 in the span of four weeks so thursday would be a great time for jesse minter to pull a rabbit out of a hat he made his bones as a defensive coordinator and he still has elite talent to work with on that side of the ball including all pro safety kyle hamilton of course baltimore won t have any hope on thursday night if it can t get two time rushing king derrick henry going he has not reached 60 rushing yards in any game during the team s losing streak and now he ll face a defense that will undoubtedly be expecting a steady diet of henry carries with an undrafted rookie making his first career start under center the jaguars have the no 1 rushing defense in the nfl and allow a league low 3 4 yards per carry but that unit will be tested following the loss of run stuffing defensive tackle davon hamilton who suffered a season ending torn quadriceps muscle last week

material_news_signals.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs says he isn’t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations.
material_news_signals.body_text: green bay wis green bay packers running back josh jacobs says he isn t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations that were made against him years before he pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend with all the evidence that we have and that they have at this point it s not one of those things where i m sitting back on my hands like ok am i going to play this week jacobs said wednesday it s like i kind of already know what it is so it s like it s really just up to them to make their final decision but i m not worried about feeling like i m going to miss any more time than i already have after spending the first six games of the season on the commissioner s exempt list which prevented him from playing or practicing jacobs has returned to play in the packers last two games the nfl has said its investigation into jacobs is ongoing which means he still could be subject to more discipline from the league jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to charges of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 after his then girlfriend said he had thrown her to the ground three days earlier in response to a public records request the hobart lawrence wisconsin police department released records from their investigation friday night that included the accounts of three other women who reported similar allegations from years before lawyers representing jacobs said he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the allegations that surfaced in friday s records release they said those allegations are old are hearsay and easily disproven it really feels like an attack on me and who i am and my character jacobs said wednesday and at the end of the day there s a lot of stuff being said about me that s completely false like completely made up and it s like people just run with it and i can t change that it s just one of those thing where it s like ok all i can do is try to be who i am and try not to let the negative moments change who i am and that was the biggest thing for me throughout this whole process i didn t want to go to a place where i felt like i was closed off and i m angry all the time because of what s going on in my life jacobs lawyers david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac said that one of the three women made a claim to the nfl which reviewed it and decided no action was warranted they said jacobs has kept evidence that supports his accounts and the nfl s decision the nfl has declined comment on the lawyers statement after hobart lawrence police released the records that detailed the accounts from the other women nfl spokesman brian mccarthy had said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation jacobs arrest followed a may 23 incident in which police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police a woman told them jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head copyright 2026 by the associated material_news_signals.headline: Cardinals place rookie Jeremiyah Love on IR due to high ankle sprain
material_news_signals.description: The Arizona Cardinals are placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Tuesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: jeremiyah love s rookie season has taken another turn for the worse the arizona cardinals have placed the running back on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain that is expected to knock him out for four to five weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on tuesday the no 3 overall pick had previously dealt with a different ankle sprain head coach mike lafleur said monday the cardinals also announced on tuesday that wide receiver kendrick bourne has been placed on ir love went down in the first quarter of sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and did not return he d missed the previous two contests due to injury in six games the first rounder has generated 268 yards on 76 carries with one touchdown averaging 3 4 yards per tote the bulk of his production came in a 21 carry 90 yard performance in a week 3 loss to san francisco the cardinals used a top three pick on love in april believing he could add a dynamic game changing weapon to the backfield a la bijan robinson in atlanta or jahmyr gibbs in detroit love hasn t been healthy enough for most of the season to know for sure if he has that kind of sustainable upside arizona gave love a significant workload in his first preseason action handing it off 11 times and tossing him three passes the belief at the time was that getting reps early would prepare love for the regular season gauntlet instead he left that game with a nicked up ankle he hasn t seemed right since perhaps shutting the rb down for at least four games will allow him to come back fully healthy for the season s stretch run in the meantime tyler allgeier who sparked the cardinals comeback win over the cowboys figures to get the bulk of the totes fellow back bam knight currently is in the league s concussion protocol and veteran james conner remains on injured reserve evan hull is currently the healthy backup option for allgeier

material_news_signals.description: San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan on Wednesday discussed his team's pursuit of a deal for veteran receiver Jauan Jennings.
material_news_signals.body_text: the san francisco 49ers find themselves in another division title race and in need of some help at receiver naturally the 49ers turned toward a familiar face former niner and current vikings receiver jauan jennings when contemplating potential acquisitions ahead of tuesday s trade deadline as things moved closer toward possibly becoming a reality head coach kyle shanahan was permitted to talk with his former receiver about a potential deal and learned jennings was not interested in a reunion we love jauan we have such a good relationship with jauan and know him really well and we didn t want to do it without talking to him first shanahan explained wednesday when asked about an earlier report on their interest in jennings so we had to agree on some things to at least make it close enough to be able to talk to him then when we got on a facetime with j j it went well it was awesome we talked about a lot of stuff and he ended up saying that he was happy with where he was it wasn t just like a definite no first but he was like man kyle i m pretty happy here and liking stuff and when i heard the way he talked and where we re at i agreed with him so it was a good conversation and something that was possible but that s why it didn t go down a trusted secondary option during his five years spent in san francisco jennings embraced his next professional opportunity with a vikings team that welcomed him in as the third option behind justin jefferson and jordan addison in 2026 on paper the fit made sense jennings reliable production would pair nicely with jefferson addison and an offense that was expected to be propelled by quarterback kyler murray the results haven t matched the expectation minnesota is 6 1 but has earned those victories on the back of its elite defense while the offense has lagged significantly behind unsurprisingly jennings has proven to be irrelevant in the low ceiling offense catching six passes for 54 yards in six games one might believe that would lead jennings to want out but as shanahan discovered jennings seems to be enjoying the vikings success despite his lack of involvement with that door closed the 49ers will have to look elsewhere for help in a position group that already lost ricky pearsall to a season ending knee injury and is still hoping mike evans can return before long from a week 7 achilles injury they look every week to see who you can add week in and week out shanahan said of san francisco s pursuit of an addition at receiver it gets bigger as the trade deadline comes but j j was someone we knew so someone we wanted to talk to if we went through with that and they were willing to do it at the time we wanted to have a conversation with him knowing the guy receivers is something we still are looking into and so is every other position jennings meanwhile will hope minnesota s 31st ranked passing attack can find a rhythm before december

material_news_signals.description: The free-falling Philadelphia Eagles are making a quarterback change in hopes of jumpstarting a flailing offense.
material_news_signals.body_text: the free falling philadelphia eagles are making a quarterback change in hopes of jumpstarting a flailing offense the eagles are naming joe milton as their starting qb and benching tanner mckee for sunday s game versus the new york giants nfl network s mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported the eagles signed milton off the dallas cowboys practice squad on oct 16 after starter jalen hurts went on injured reserve due to blood clots a 2024 sixth round pick by the new england patriots milton has appeared in five games in his career all as a reserve while he wasn t the official starter in week 18 of his rookie campaign with the patriots he played the bulk of the tilt completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and ran for another score last year in dallas he subbed in four tilts completing 15 of 24 passes for 183 yards with a td and two ints and rushing for 50 yards on five carries an enticing athlete milton brings a completely different style from mckee milton s ability to use his legs should help an offense that has struggled to block and suffered far too many stalled drives the strong armed 26 year old can hunt big plays which also can get him into trouble he ll get a shot to prove he can evolve with more seasoning in philly the eagles bench mckee after three starts all losses he completed 72 of 114 passes for 638 yards and two tds with two ints in sunday s loss to washington the eagles couldn t find consistent offense under mckee after the first quarter and a 10 0 lead turned into a 27 10 loss mckee lost the preseason backup battle to andy dalton and entered the season as qb3 however after dalton s one wayward interception against the bears in week 3 while hurts was getting checked for a concussion philly moved on from dalton who eventually signed in atlanta now the eagles are on to qb4 with sixth straight losses philly s season feels all but over for nick sirianni s club it doesn t hurt to see what an athlete like milton could provide things can t get much worse and milton at least provides the upside to make the offense exciting once in a while

material_news_signals.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
material_news_signals.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at

unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 9 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 2 p m et on thursday nov 5 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl thursday nov 5 why bobby picked the jaguars jacksonville enters thursday night with the no 5 scoring offense and no 2 defense in points allowed while baltimore is limping into the prime time contest without star quarterback lamar jackson thumb for the long term not only that but backup tyler huntley is out for the season due to a turf toe injury there is a trade for jacoby brissett in the works but for at least one game the baton passes to undrafted rookie qb joe fagnano who went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception after being thrust into the ravens week 8 loss to the bills as their emergency option will he improve enough to make a difference with an abbreviated week to prepare for his first ever nfl start it s hard to imagine especially facing a defense boasting the seventh highest pressure rate 39 6 in the league derrick henry has struggled during baltimore s three game losing streak he hasn t topped 58 yards rushing in any of those contests and zay flowers just put up a goose egg zero catches on five targets versus buffalo things are at risk of falling apart and the ravens don t exactly have one of their classic shutdown defenses of yesteryear to come to the rescue sunday nov 8 why gennaro picked the bengals joe burrow and michael penix are both coming off career days burrow notched a career best six total touchdowns in an overtime win penix threw a career worst four interceptions in a rain soaked loss but i m not here today to talk about either quarterback rather i d like to spotlight a bengals receiver and it isn t the one we usually fawn over yes this is a tee higgins appreciation blurb typically overshadowed by perennial pro bowler ja marr chase higgins currently ranks second in the nfl behind only jaxon smith njigba with 636 receiving yards putting him on pace for nearly 1 800 yards on the season the 6 foot 4 220 pounder has always been a beast at the catch point but he s become a true monster after the catch this season owning a career high rate in missed tackles forced 27 9 per next gen stats in related news nfl research tells me that burrow and higgins comfortably boast the highest passer rating of any qb wr combo in the league min 45 targets at 132 3 of course burrow and chase still rank fifth in that category at 113 6 leading me to the larger point here we ve all been saying cincinnati has two wr1s for years nowadays that almost feels like an undersell the bengals have two of the most frightening offensive weapons in the league at the moment with higgins 10 155 2 and chase 11 141 1 both posting primo stat lines last sunday and this week they draw an atlanta cb group that s been marred by injuries and inconsistency in a potential shootout on the international stage give me the league s best receiving duo why gennaro picked the panthers riding a four game win streak denver has shot to the top of the afc west and yet there are still plenty of reasons to doubt these broncos the offense quite frankly is boring well until bo nix decides to put together a game winning drive and the defense while solid in some of the advanced statistics just hasn t been the shutdown unit of the past two seasons ranking 20th against the pass 25th against the run and 25th on third down yes denver s a perfect 4 0 at home compiling an impressive collection of victories over the jaguars rams seahawks and chiefs but this week s game is in charlotte and away from mile high the broncos have been rather unremarkable beating the also rans chargers cardinals and losing to the contenders chiefs 49ers which brings us to the panthers are they an also ran or a contender honestly it s kind of hard to say despite being below 500 they currently sit atop a dull nfc south and while they opened october with an impressive win over the lions they closed the month with one sided defeats to the buccaneers and packers consequently this feels like a midseason hinge game especially with carolina set to hit the road in three of the next four weeks now it s possible denver s pass rush just overwhelms carolina s battered offensive line and the firing of dc ejiro evero could either spark or spike the panthers defense but with carolina having a few extra days to recuperate and regroup following last week s appearance on thursday night football i envision dave canales rallying his plucky team to a narrow home win over a broncos squad that currently feels far closer to 6 3 than 7 2 why jeremy picked the cowboys it s a matchup of fire sale vs fire everybody the colts and cowboys are entering sunday s game at arguably the lowest points of each of their seasons indy is more focused on the trade deadline than the play between the lines despite what shane steichen has to say dallas is coming off an unthinkable comeback defeat at home against the cardinals casting doubt on whether it can really compete in a limp nfc east something s gotta give jonathan taylor is set up for a big day against dallas the 32nd ranked run defense in the league but the colts rb has recently been corralled by opposing defenses all while trade rumors swirl the more defining matchup sunday will be whether indianapolis can slow down dak prescott ceedee lamb and george pickens who can put up yards and points against the colts 30th ranked scoring defense with javonte williams getting good touches against the league s least efficient run defense the cowboys should wrangle the colts on sunday unless their lasso loosens in the second half again why dan picked the chiefs while both teams enter week 9 on a losing streak there are not many games that could offer a better get right environment to the chiefs than a meeting with the jets at home kansas city s offense has taken a step back with injury woes at receiver and defenses bottling up kenneth walker but gang green should offer far less resistance than seattle and denver did in the last two weeks aaron glenn s crew has allowed 30 7 points per game during its three game losing streak second most in the league no team has allowed more epa per dropback over the last two weeks than new york 0 53 and that was against the likes of malik willis and kirk cousins glenn s offense is coming off a season high 33 point performance but geno smith might be without his top weapon garrett wilson who is in the concussion protocol it s been more than two years since the jets won on the road against an above 500 team and it would take a very uninspired performance from patrick mahomes and co to end that skid on sunday why bobby picked the lions miami has played better after its week 6 bye beating the jets and then holding an ill fated double digit halftime lead over the patriots but detroit also seems to be finding its stride after going 2 2 over the first month of the season with the two wins feeling far more contested than the losses the lions have now rattled off three consecutive victories detroit s achilles heel the defense has improved during the winning streak the lions have allowed their three fewest point totals and three fewest yardage totals of the season in the past three contests giving up a per game average of 17 7 points and 305 7 yards since week 5 compared to 31 8 points and 423 8 yards between week 1 4 it s a touch dramatic to call a nov 8 game for a 5 2 team a must win but that s how brutal the nfc north is the lions simply can t afford to drop a game against a one win team when they have four tough divisional matchups still to go plus dates with the patriots a resurgent buccaneers club a falcons team that knocked the 49ers off their unbeaten perch and the nfc east leading giants they know that and as the superior squad they ll play like it why brooke picked the saints shedeur sanders is in line to start for the browns with deshaun watson who was playing his best ball since 2020 entering concussion protocol earlier this week the biggest difference with sanders under center appears to be his willingness to stretch the field as his 7 1 air yards per target in 2025 are more than watson s 6 7 mark through eight games this season sanders is also working with a better receivers than he did a year ago with rookies denzel boston and kc concepcion earning big roles in todd monken s offense none of that will ultimately matter if the run game is dormant as it was last week 34 yards in oc mcvay s rams played in landover during 2020 but that year never happened if you think about it mcvay returns to the nation s capital at a critical juncture with the once super bowl favorites at 4 4
